This is the first public build of Meldo for Android. It's an early alpha: the main features work, but expect rough edges and bugs. Feedback is very welcome.

## What Meldo does

Meldo is a free school planner for students in Germany. It has no account, no ads and no tracking.

- **Hand-raises (Meldungen):** count one with a single tap in the app, from a widget or from the Quick Settings tile. If phones stay in the bag during class, Meldo asks once after each lesson instead.
- **Timetable:** type it in or import it from your school's WebUntis server, with substitutions, cancellations and room changes. The current lesson shows as a Live Update.
- **Grades:** see your average per subject on the 1 to 6 scale or the 0 to 15 point scale. Weighting and rounding are settings, so they can match your school's rules.
- **Homework and exams:** reminders, an exam calendar, worksheet scans to PDF, an optional Microsoft Teams import and excuse notes.
- **Your data stays on your phone.** Meldo has no server. Backup and sync are optional and go to your own Google Drive, encrypted on the device before anything leaves it.
- German and English, light and dark mode.

## How to install

You need a phone or tablet with Android 8 or newer.

1. On your phone, open this page and tap **`Meldo-0.0.1.apk`** under **Assets** below to download it.
2. Open the downloaded file, from the download notification or from your **Files** app.
3. Android will say that your browser (or Files app) isn't allowed to install apps. Tap **Settings**, turn on **Allow from this source**, then go back.
4. Tap **Install**. If Google Play Protect asks about an unknown app, you can let it scan the app or choose to install anyway.
5. Open Meldo and follow the setup.

The wording of these screens differs a little between phone makers. Later versions are installed the same way and update Meldo without losing your data.

## Known limitations

- This is an alpha. Some screens and texts will still change, and you may run into bugs.
- Updates are not automatic. Check this page for new versions.
- Meldo is not on Google Play. GitHub Releases is the only place to get it.
- The APK runs on 64-bit devices only (arm64 and x86_64). Very old 32-bit phones can't install it.
- WebUntis import depends on your school's server and its settings, so it may not work at every school.
- Timetables and grades in Meldo can differ from your school's records. Your school's records always count.

## Found a bug?

Please open an issue at [github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/issues](https://github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/issues). Tell us your phone model, your Android version and what you did before the problem happened. For security problems, please follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue.

## Kurz auf Deutsch

Das ist die erste öffentliche Alpha von Meldo für Android. Meldo ist ein kostenloser Schulplaner: Meldungen zählen, Stundenplan (auch aus WebUntis), Noten nach 1 bis 6 oder 0 bis 15 Punkten, Hausaufgaben und Klausuren. Deine Daten bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

So installierst du die App: Lade `Meldo-0.0.1.apk` unten unter **Assets** herunter, öffne die Datei und erlaube in den Einstellungen die Installation aus dieser Quelle. Du brauchst Android 8 oder neuer. Weil es eine Alpha ist, kann noch nicht alles rund laufen. Fehler meldest du am besten als [Issue hier auf GitHub](https://github.com/Meldo-dev/meldo-android/issues).
